 How to Watch South Carolina vs Oklahoma
 When: Saturday, October 31, 2026
 Time: 4:15 PM ET
 TV Channel: SEC Network
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement South Carolina has won two straight games after beating No. 11 Tennessee 27-24 on Saturday. Quarterback LaNorris Sellers threw for 210 yards and a touchdown while rushing for 96 yards and two more scores. Mazeo Bennett Jr. caught six passes for 88 yards and a touchdown as the Gamecocks improved to 2-3 in SEC play. South Carolina led 14-0 early but trailed 24-17 late in the fourth quarter, as Sellers tied the game with a four-yard touchdown run with 1:17 remaining, and Malik Orsan kicked a 48-yard field goal as time expired to give the Gamecocks the win.
 Oklahoma beat Mississippi State 23-15 last Saturday to improve to 2-2 in conference play. John Mateer completed 22 of 29 passes for 283 yards and two touchdowns, connecting with Isaiah Sategna III for a 36-yard score and Rocky Beers for a 32-yard touchdown. Sategna finished with 164 receiving yards, while Tory Blaylock rushed for 71 yards on 12 carries. The Sooners led 17-0 early in the third quarter and finished with 467 yards of total offense. Oklahoma has won two of its last three games and will try to keep that momentum going as both teams look to stay above the .500 mark.
